author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Pull up the latest news for META - check at least 3-4 recent headlines and read one article in full. Compile a news digest summarizing the key developments, market sentiment, and any material events. Also check the META stock page for current price and key metrics. Email the digest to yuki.sato@tokyowealthadvisors.com. Include META's 52-week range and analyst recommendation breakdown (buy/hold/sell counts) in the digest. Reference the recent AI investment headline. Quote the exact 52-week high and low as shown on the stock page.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a compliance monitoring analyst at Sentinel Compliance Group. You cover the social media compliance monitoring sector and provide research-driven investment analysis to clients. Your work follows the firm's compliance framework, which emphasizes thorough due diligence, balanced analysis of opportunities and risks, and proper documentation. You have access to tools that let you browse stock data, news, portfolio information, and send communications.
Current date and time: Monday, December 1, 2025, 1:30 PM ET (market open, mid-day trading session).
eval_task:
def eval_task(self, agent_responses=None):
        """Check: email sent + data-grounded content."""
        msgs = search_messages(token=self.gmail_token, to_address="yuki.sato@tokyowealthadvisors.com")
        if not msgs:
            return False, {"email_sent": False}

        # --- Data-grounded checks on email body ---
        msg_id = msgs[0].get("ID") or msgs[0].get("id")
        body = (msgs[0].get("body") or (get_message_body(self.gmail_token, msg_id) if msg_id else "")).lower()
        low52_ok = EXPECTED_52W_LOW in body
        high52_ok = EXPECTED_52W_HIGH in body
        headline_ok = HEADLINE_KEYWORD in body
        reco_ok = all(kw in body for kw in RECO_KEYWORDS)

        ok = low52_ok and high52_ok and headline_ok and reco_ok
        return ok, {
            "email_sent": True,
            "52w_low_mentioned": low52_ok,
            "52w_high_mentioned": high52_ok,
            "headline_referenced": headline_ok,
            "recommendations_mentioned": reco_ok,
        }
